title: Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout Ionic Digital sold about 737 bitcoin for roughly $61.6 million after Sept. 30 and plans to use the cash to develop its data center sites, its latest quarterly report shows. This post Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
